rationale: rule:prospecting_default

There is near-term intent (packaging project in eight weeks, wants commercial info this week) and a clear pain point, but spend level and the purchase signer are unknown and the founder is absent; the drawing already permits several optical technologies, so spec fit is not the blocker.

There is near-term intent (packaging project starting in eight weeks, drawing allows optical sensors, no incumbent), but the controls engineer cannot state the spend or who signs component purchases and the founder has disengaged, so purchasing authority must be confirmed first.
rule:technical_review_with_incumbent

Concrete technical requirement (chemical compatibility of wetted parts with a specified cleaning liquid at given concentration and temperature) is unconfirmed, and the engineer can supply the composition data in writing, so a document-based spec review resolves the open fit question before any trial.

Product fit hinges on unconfirmed chemical compatibility of the wetted parts with the new cleaning liquid, and the engineer can supply composition, concentration and temperature in writing — a document-based compatibility check per application is the gating step before any trial; budget, authority, price and delivery are already settled.
rule:trust_concern_with_incumbent_late

Interface, resolution, mounting specs plus price and delivery are already signed off and budget authority exists for a limited quantity; the remaining barrier is the engineer's doubt about stable readings during real winding cycles and refusal to swap all encoders at once, which a limited trial on the one available machine directly addresses.

Specs, price and delivery are signed off and purchasing has authority, but with an unreliable incumbent the remaining doubt is encoder stability during real winding cycles and refusal to swap all units at once — a limited quantity on one available machine addresses exactly that performance risk.
rule:trust_concern

Budget is set aside and the published range fits, so the only barrier is her doubt about our experience with ceramic equipment manufacturers; trust must be established before any trial, and she has not made equipment available for evaluation.

The owner has budget and says the published range fits, so the only barrier is doubt about our experience and service expectations in the ceramic equipment sector — a supplier-trust concern, and she has not yet offered equipment for product evaluation.
rule:supplier_audit_required

Specs, pricing and budget are already agreed; the only remaining barrier is the customer's supplier admission procedure requiring an in-person audit of calibration and traceability at our premises, which documents cannot satisfy, and the quality manager has stated availability next month.

Specs, budget, pricing and delivery are all settled; the only remaining barrier is the customer's formal supplier admission procedure, which requires its auditor to inspect calibration and traceability in person at our premises, and the quality manager already has an open afternoon next month.
rule:price_objection_late_stage

Validation is complete and delivery, warranty and payment terms are accepted, with the owner as sole decision maker and a near-term order window, so the only remaining barrier is the requested twelve percent discount, which she explicitly says lot-splitting will not change.

Validation is complete and terms accepted, with the owner as sole decision maker and near-term timing; the only remaining barrier is a 12 percent discount, far above the 5 percent sales authority, so the sales director must approve.
rule:prospecting_default

Technical fit is confirmed and the customer keeps our catalogue for a planned redesign, but both engineering and purchasing state no purchases or supplier change before the redesign in eighteen months, so there is a real future opportunity with no near-term intent.

Technical fit is confirmed (compact housing and electrical interface match) but both engineering and purchasing agree no purchase or supplier change will occur before the redesign in ~18 months, which matches the typical machine-builder design cycle — a real future opportunity, not a hard mismatch.
rule:qualifying_default

A one-off need for four units with a confirmed zero repeat volume cannot support a custom housing development, and no standard catalogue housing fits the fixed mounting space — a hard fit/volume mismatch that time will not change.

The fixed mounting space requires a custom housing, which carries a hard 300-unit minimum with no exceptions, while the workshop needs only four units and confirms no further demand over the exhibit's lifetime, so time will not close the gap.
rule:budget_or_authority_unclear

Specs appear to match and price is acceptable, and there is near-term intent (replacement needed within six weeks), but conflicting budget signals (frozen equipment budget vs. separate maintenance account with unknown balance) and an unresponsive purchasing manager mean funding source and signing authority must be clarified first.

Specs and price appear acceptable and the engineer states a six-week replacement need, but it is unresolved whether the purchase falls under the frozen equipment budget or a separate maintenance account, and the purchasing manager who signs orders has not responded.
rule:prospecting_default

Budget, decision team and timing are already established, but the fit is unconfirmed: engineering asks what repeatability is achievable on polished, curved, moving targets and refuses to sign off on catalogue figures, while all needed data (reflectivity, drawings, speed profiles, tolerances) can be supplied electronically, so a documented spec review rather than a site visit is the next step.

Specs are concrete (1 m range, target repeatability) but fit on polished, curved, moving surfaces is unconfirmed, and the LD series repeatability figure only holds for flat matte static targets; the customer can supply reflectivity data, drawings, speed profiles and tolerances electronically, so a document-based spec review resolves the open question before any trial.
rule:trust_concern_with_incumbent_late

Specs are signed off, commercial terms and budget are accepted, and supplier qualification is complete; the only open issue is unproven sustained performance on dusty produce, with an idle spare lane and purchasing able to release a small quantity.

Specs are signed off, supplier qualification is complete, budget and commercial terms accepted; the only remaining doubt is sustained sensor performance on dusty produce in the customer's own process, and an idle sorting lane plus purchasing authority for a small quantity make a limited trial the natural next step.
rule:trust_concern

Funding, roles and timing are in place and specs are considered suitable, but management doubts our experience in laundry machinery and explicitly blocks any evaluation resources until comparable-industry references are provided, so trust must be established first.

The blocker is doubt about our experience and service understanding in laundry machinery, and management will not commit evaluation resources until references from a comparable business are provided; funding, roles, specs and price are already settled.
rule:technical_review_with_incumbent

Electrical interface and measurement range already match, so the open issue is purely the on-site mounting clearance and cable route behind a moving guard, which the customer says can only be measured beside running equipment; budget, decision maker and terms are settled and a maintenance window opens in three weeks.

Specs and commercials are settled, but the mounting clearance and cable route behind a moving guard cannot be determined from drawings or photos and must be measured at the running machine during the maintenance window opening in three weeks.
rule:price_objection_late_stage
Specs, quality approval, terms and authority are all settled, leaving a 14% discount demand beyond normal seller authority as the sole remaining barrier, with a board award deadline at month end.

Technical acceptance, supplier admission and delivery/payment terms are all complete, leaving a 14 percent discount demand as the only barrier — far above the 5 percent sales authority — and the award-authorized purchasing director has set a firm deadline tied to her board meeting.
rule:no_near_term_plan

Fit is confirmed (enclosure dimensions and interface match) and funds are expected in the normal planning cycle, but an exclusive incumbent agreement runs for eleven more months and both managers have ruled out any transaction until it expires, with the next design generation starting roughly two months after that.

Fit is confirmed technically but an exclusive agreement runs for eleven more months and both managers have ruled out any transaction until it expires, with detailed design for the next generation starting about two months later — a clear future opportunity, not a mismatch.
rule:technical_review_default

The customer has sent a frozen, concrete specification (continuous 420 °C sensor head in a sealed space with no remote mounting or sleeve) and has asked which product we would offer, but nothing in the available facts confirms whether our sensor range meets that temperature and form-factor limit, so internal specification fit must be verified before quoting or trialling.

The frozen customer specification requires continuous operation at 420 degrees Celsius in a sealed space with no option for remote mounting or a protective sleeve, and the engineering director confirms temperature and space cannot change; this exceeds our sensor range (e.g. MS series rated 0-90 degrees Celsius), making it a hard requirement mismatch that time and funding will not resolve.
rule:proposal_default

Specs are technically accepted and delivery timing fits a near-term need (production in ten weeks), but neither the integrator's purchasing office nor the manufacturer's central team is confirmed as the ordering party and no spending allocation exists; the approving engineer has no purchasing authority.

Specs are technically accepted and there is near-term intent (production in ten weeks), but it is unsettled whether the integrator's purchasing or the manufacturer's central team will order, no spending allocation is confirmed, and the approving engineer has no purchasing authority.
rule:qualifying_default

Budget, authority and timing are confirmed and price is accepted, but the pressure transmitter's fit is unverified because startup pressure peaks and repeated overload duration are missing; the customer can send logs and drawings electronically, so a document-based spec review suffices rather than a site visit.

Budget and timing are confirmed and price accepted, but the startup pressure peaks and repeated overload duration are unknown, which is exactly the application check needed against the PC series 1.5x overload limit; the customer can send operating logs and drawings electronically.
rule:negotiation_default

Price, delivery and specifications are already agreed and the incumbent is discontinuing the housing, but operators' fear of unexpected stops over a full shift is a product-performance risk; procurement has funds for a limited initial quantity and an isolated line is available, making a trial run the natural next step.

Specs, price and terms are settled and the incumbent is discontinuing the housing, so the only barrier is the operators' product-performance doubt about stability over a full shift; procurement has funds and an isolated line for a limited initial quantity.
rule:technical_review_default

Specs and funding are already accepted, so the only barrier is the operations director's belief that we serve only laboratory equipment firms and lack continuous-production/paper-converting support experience — credibility must be established before machine time (a trial) can be released.

Specs and funding are already accepted; the sole barrier is the operations director's doubt that we serve anything beyond laboratory equipment and understand continuous paper-converting production, and she has blocked machine time, so trust in our industry experience must be established before any trial.
rule:supplier_audit_required

Specs and budget are already accepted, but the customer's quality policy mandates an on-site auditor witnessing calibration and assembly identification at our premises, with photos or video calls explicitly rejected — a document or remote review cannot satisfy this supplier qualification gate.

Specs and budget are already accepted, but this medium manufacturer's quality policy requires an on-site auditor to witness calibration and assembly identification before supplier admission, and photos or video calls are explicitly refused; the 'early lead' stage label lags the actual situation.
rule:price_objection_late_stage

All technical, approval, payment and delivery items are settled with funded annual volume of 6,000 units; the only remaining barrier is an 8% discount demand (92 vs 100) that the buyer refuses to trade against service or shipping terms, so it needs approval above the seller's authority.

Technical acceptance, supplier approval, payment terms and delivery dates are all complete, so price is the only remaining barrier: the buyer holds a firm ceiling of 92 against the quoted 100 for a funded 6,000-unit annual requirement, and non-price concessions are explicitly rejected.
rule:technical_review_default

Technical fit is confirmed and we are an approved supplier, but the board postponed the machine platform to the next financial year with no component purchases for at least nine months, so the opportunity is real but not near-term.

Technical fit is confirmed and we are an approved supplier, but the machine platform is postponed with no component purchases for at least nine months; engineering retains the approved drawings, so the opportunity returns when the programme restarts.
rule:prospecting_default

The signed engineering requirement permits only the controller vendor's proprietary protocol, protocol converters are contractually forbidden, and the controller cannot be changed, so any sensor without that native interface is a fundamental specification mismatch that time or budget will not resolve.

The contract locks the controller vendor's proprietary protocol and forbids gateways, while the LP series supports only SSI, IO-Link and analog and no customer-specific firmware or gateways — an unchangeable hard requirement mismatch that budget and timing cannot resolve.
rule:negotiation_default

Specs and price are already accepted, so the only open issue is authority and budget: the purchasing contact claims verbal owner approval and a spare-parts exemption for next month, while the owner states capital spending is suspended and no approval record has been produced.

Specs and price are accepted, but there is a contradiction between the owner's capital spending freeze and the contact's unverified claim that these sensors are spare-parts budget with a verbal approval for next month; near-term intent exists, so budget classification and the approval record must be confirmed with finance/owner.
rule:proposal_default

A 50 mPa·s vs 12,000 mPa·s viscosity discrepancy leaves the flow sensor's technical fit unconfirmed, and the engineer is sending fluid and temperature records today; commercial terms are already agreed, so the only open item is the specification match.

The requirement sheet states 50 mPa·s while a later process note gives 12,000 mPa·s, which exceeds the FL series limit of 2,000 mPa·s, so product fit is unconfirmed until the engineer's fluid and temperature records resolve the contradiction; commercial terms are already settled.
rule:trust_concern

All dimensions, signal, speed and resolution specs were verified and signed off and pricing is accepted, with supply difficulty at the incumbent as switch motive; the only remaining doubt is product performance (counting stability during repeated start/stop), and the owner can authorize a limited quantity with a spare machine available for trial.

Specs were fully signed off by the engineer, terms accepted, and the owner has funds and authority for a limited quantity; the only remaining concern is unproven counting stability during start/stop, which a small trial on the spare machine addresses while the incumbent stays in use.
rule:proposal_default

Specs, price, delivery and paperwork are accepted; the only barrier is the owner's doubt that we have experience in dusty cutting workshops rather than electronics assembly, and he won't commit technician or machine time (i.e., no trial) until that credibility is established.

The only remaining barrier is the owner's doubt that we have experience in dusty cutting workshops rather than electronics assembly; he withholds technician and machine time until trust is established, so a cutting-application report is the right next step.
rule:budget_or_authority_unclear

Specs and price are already accepted and funding exists; the only remaining barrier is the large customer's mandatory supplier qualification audit requiring on-site observation of our production line and serial-number traceability, which certificates cannot waive.

Specs and price are accepted and funding exists; the only barrier is the customer's quality rule requiring on-site observation of our production line and serial-number traceability, which certificates cannot waive.
rule:price_objection_late_stage

Technical fit and approvals are complete and the only remaining barrier is the owner's fixed requirement of a nine percent price reduction, which he says no spec, logistics or volume change would alter, so the discount decision must go above the seller's authority.

Technical acceptance, approval and commercial terms are all settled, leaving only an explicit price objection of nine percent, which exceeds the 5 percent discount authority of sales staff and requires sales director approval.
rule:negotiation_default

Technical and commercial terms are already agreed and our product remains on the approved list, but the machine programme is postponed twelve months with no near-term need, so the opportunity is real yet deferred rather than lost.

Technical and commercial terms are agreed and our product remains on the approved supplier list, but the machine programme is postponed twelve months and the purchase date was withdrawn with no interim component need — a future opportunity, not a mismatch.
rule:technical_review_with_incumbent

The customer has a finalized, hard technical requirement (battery-free true absolute position immediately after power loss, no homing) with budget, volume and delivery date already given, but our product's conformance to that spec has not been confirmed yet.

The finalized design hard-requires absolute position after power loss with no homing and no battery backup, but the RE series is incremental only with no absolute version or position-retaining accessory planned, so no product can meet this fixed requirement.
rule:budget_or_authority_unclear

Technical acceptance is complete and parts are needed in seven weeks with pricing already acceptable, but neither division owns the component budget, no purchasing signer is identified, and finance has no funding request — so budget ownership and authority must be qualified.

Technical acceptance is complete and there is near-term intent (parts needed in seven weeks) with acceptable pricing, but neither division owns the component budget, no purchasing manager is identified, and finance has received no funding request.
rule:price_objection_late_stage

The accepted specification is now contradicted by an added hotter cleaning cycle and nobody has confirmed which revision governs, so product fit is unconfirmed; the engineer can send the cycle record electronically, making a document review sufficient before any price negotiation.

Two conflicting temperature requirements exist (a new hotter cleaning cycle vs. an older email confirming the original temperature) and nobody has confirmed which revision governs, so product fit is unconfirmed; the engineer can supply the cycle record electronically, making a document review sufficient before any price concession is considered.
rule:trust_concern_with_incumbent_late

Specs and proposal terms are accepted, the incumbent's delays give a switch motive, and the clarified concern is detection consistency during dusty shifts on their own line — a product performance risk; funds, authority and a separate production cell for a limited quantity are in place and management wants operating evidence.

Specifications and proposal terms are already accepted and the remaining doubt is product performance—detection consistency during dusty shifts on the customer's own line—not supplier qualification; funds, a separate production cell and authority for a limited quantity exist, and management wants operating evidence before a full switch.
rule:trust_concern_with_incumbent_late

Specs, price and delivery are already accepted; the sole remaining barrier is management's doubt about our track record with battery machinery businesses, and the operations director will not release machine time or funds for any trial until that credibility question is answered.

Specs, price and delivery are accepted, but management doubts our track record with battery machinery businesses and will not release machine time or funds for a trial until that is answered, so supplier credibility must be established before any pilot.
rule:negotiation_default

All commercial and technical terms are settled; the only open item is that the quality head, who signs supplier admission, requires on-site witnessing of calibration handling, so document review is explicitly insufficient.

All commercial and technical terms are settled; the only remaining barrier is the quality head's requirement to witness calibration handling at our premises for final supplier admission, which documents cannot replace.
rule:qualifying_default

Engineering/quality approvals are done, volume (22,000 units/yr) and warranty, payment and delivery terms are accepted, and the buyer has award authority — the only open item is a 13% reduction to fit the approved component allowance, which is beyond normal seller discount latitude.

Engineering and quality approvals are already done and the buyer has award authority with a confirmed 22,000-unit annual volume; price is the only open barrier, and the required 13 percent discount far exceeds the 5 percent sales authority.
rule:prospecting_default

The programme director and purchasing head confirmed the feature is deferred fifteen months with no parts or evaluation spend authorized, so despite a good spec fit there is no near-term purchase; the engineer's 'urgent' emails and the stale note do not override the decision makers, and the fit means a future opportunity remains.

Spec fit is good and there is no incumbent, but the programme director and purchasing head confirmed this week that the feature is deferred 15 months with no parts or evaluation spend authorized, which supersedes last quarter's urgency note and the engineer's stale 'urgent' emails.
rule:hard_requirement_unmet

The buyer has a concrete, non-negotiable requirement (independent hygienic certification for every wetted sensor assembly) plus budget and ~600 units/year, but nothing in the scenario confirms our sensors hold that third-party certification, so specification fit must be verified before any trial or disqualification.

The end customer's signed spec mandates independent third-party hygienic certification for wetted sensor assemblies and will not accept a manufacturer's declaration, while the LV series carries no such certification and can only offer a declaration; the requirement is fixed by design approval and cannot be waived.
